calls.title: Ashley / Alyssa 1:1
calls.summary: During the meeting, the team addressed the complexity of onboarding, emphasizing the need for simplification to enhance user engagement and reduce drop-off rates. Ashley Stirrup presented a case study demonstrating that reducing setup time significantly boosts user satisfaction. Alyssa Nicoll committed to creating a Notion ticket for engineering efforts aimed at streamlining onboarding. Additionally, Alyssa will oversee updates to the public-facing product roadmap, ensuring community feedback is accurately represented. A focus on producing short demo videos to educate users on new features, particularly around experimentation, was highlighted. The integration of the beta event forwarder feature aimed at improving the analytics experience was also discussed, alongside the need to increase user interaction as current statistics indicated low engagement. Balancing immediate project demands with long-term improvements while awaiting key stakeholder input was emphasized as critical.
calls.keywords: AI onboarding, Visual Editor, event forwarder, roadmap communication, user engagement, product demos

calls.title: Ashley / Alyssa 1:1
calls.summary: The meeting addressed the need for improved community engagement, highlighting the questioning of GitHub as a participation layer and the request for usage data. Engineering community events were proposed to occur quarterly instead of monthly to focus on key highlights. Slack integration was discussed as a value-add for live chats and micro communities, though not suited for a full documentation hub, prompting consideration of platforms like Discourse. GitHub discussions were identified as a central hub for hosting RFCs, roadmaps, and customer learnings but currently exhibit low activity, necessitating a strategy to boost engagement through product leads and Slack. Ongoing work includes docs migration and community discovery scheduled quarterly, while ensuring prioritization of urgent tasks to manage resources effectively.
calls.keywords: GitHub Discussions, Slack Community, Customer Interviews, Developer Engagement, Community Amplification, Feedback Gathering
